newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master sees Q4 shr at $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master sees Q4 shr at $0.08.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc foresees its net income per share ranging between $0.07 and $0.09 per share for its fiscal fourth quarter, according to preliminary results.
The company said in a statement that the results also projected income per share for its 1996 fiscal year to reach between $0.24 and $0.26.
The official figures for the quarter and fiscal year, which ended October 31, would come out in mid-December, it added.
The figures include the "Let It Ride" prize funds as well as costs incurred in marketing a new video game and signing two inventors to an exclusive services agreement, the company said.

The fiscal-year per-share figure reflects operating income gains of more than 270 percent over the previous year, which was partly offset by a one-time $3.4 million first-quarter 1996 loss on notes receivable and a tax expense, it said.
The company said revenues totalled $8.6 million for the quarter and $36.7 million for the year.
It said it could not compare the figures with those from the previous year due to changes to the structure of the prize fund.
The company, which provides products and services for the gambling industry, said it also projected 1997 revenues to reach between $44 milion and $48 million or $0.50 per share and $0.60 per share.
Its board of directors, which presented the figures to a group of analysts in a private meeting on Monday, also approved the purchase of $5 million worth of the company's own stock, it said.
